imports.title: Structured imports
imports.subtitle: Review CSV mappings and every row before saving. Up to 100 records and 256 KiB per atomic import.
imports.intro: People imports maintain roster records. They do not create logins or send invitations. Songbook PDFs and Word files remain documents.
imports.mappingHelp: Blank mapped values clear nullable fields; unmapped fields stay unchanged on updates. Separate tags with semicolons.
imports.previewHelp: Preview itself writes no records or jobs. Resolve all errors and possible duplicates before saving; retries reuse the same saved review.
imports.candidatesTruncated_one: Showing 10 of {{count}} match. Use the exact stable ID in the CSV to choose another target.
imports.candidatesTruncated_other: Showing 10 of {{count}} matches. Use the exact stable ID in the CSV to choose another target.
imports.resolutionChanged: Resolution changed. Refresh the preview to review the new result.
imports.jobReviewed: Review saved. Commit is pending or unconfirmed; check status or retry the entire batch.
imports.jobCommitted: All reviewed outcomes are saved. Retrying this job cannot duplicate its records.
imports.startNewHelp: If a target changed, start a fresh preview from this saved source. The old review stays unchanged in history.

arrangement.sequenceHelp: The order the sections are played in, separated by commas.

addSong.title: Add Song
addSong.chartHelp: Paste a chart with the chords on their own line above the lyrics, or write ChordPro with the chords in square brackets — <0>A[G]mazing grace</0>. Leave it blank to add the chart later.

formatting.columnsHelp: Two columns fit a long chart onto one page. Sections are never split across a column or a page break.

sequence.title: Edit Sequence
sequence.empty: Add section labels from the right to create a sequence.

curation.title: Labeled keys and files
curation.intro: Keys are sounding keys. Capo and vocal labels describe a version; chart transposition and plan selection use the sounding key. Each arrangement has one label per key.
curation.noFiles: No files selected for this key.
curation.editKeySummary: Add or edit a labeled key
curation.label: Label
curation.pitchHelp: Saved pitches stay stable for historical plan selection. Add a key for another pitch.
curation.fileScopeHelp: Assigning an owned file to a key scopes its automatic plan selection to that pitch. Clearing every key association returns owned files to general use. File audience and playback rights still apply.
curation.includeMetadata: Key, capo, tempo, meter and length
curation.includeChart: Chart and print settings (retains its source sounding key)
curation.previewChartIncluded: Chart included with its source sounding key.
curation.previewReuseNote: Reused files retain their original owner, audience, versions and playback rights.
curation.retryHelp: If the outcome is unknown, retry this reviewed duplicate with the same request. A stale review needs a fresh preview.
curation.reusedBadge: Reused file · edits affect its original

merge.intro: Suggestions match exact trimmed title or CCLI. Review deliberately; this song becomes the retained, read-only historical record. The selected song keeps its metadata and default.
merge.noSuggestions: No matching title or CCLI suggestions.
merge.coverage: Review covers both songs: {{arrangements}} arrangements, {{keys}} labeled keys, {{files}} files, {{planItems}} plan items, {{songbookItems}} songbook entries and {{templateRevisions}} template revisions.
merge.inspect: Inspect metadata, defaults, files and references
merge.arrangementsNote: Arrangements retain IDs. Names and key labels may repeat under different arrangements. Existing losing references with an inherited arrangement are fixed to its original default. General song files become shared by the kept song.
merge.templateRevision: Template {{template}} revision {{revision}} remains immutable; later use selects the kept song and original arrangement.
merge.liveHistory_one: {{count}} pinned live snapshot remains immutable. Existing offline copies refresh when the client next syncs.
merge.liveHistory_other: {{count}} pinned live snapshots remain immutable. Existing offline copies refresh when the client next syncs.
merge.retryHelp: For an unknown outcome, retry this request. Changed references require a new review. No rows are partially merged.

bulk.help: Tags use commas. An empty value clears the field. Unselected fields stay unchanged.
bulk.reviewHelp: Review each replacement before saving. Nothing has been changed yet.

mobileAuthoring.archiveArrangementConfirm: Archive “{{name}}”? It leaves the arrangement pickers; plans that use it keep it.

mobileAuthoring.stale: Someone else saved this first, so nothing was saved. Your changes are still here: load the latest version, check it, then save again.
